content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Residential property insurance underwriter; it sells policies and bears risk, unlike an office landlord leasing space."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Outdoor advertising displays sold to advertisers; different product and customers from office leasing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"HVAC and building systems contractor earning installation and service fees, not rent from leased space."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Manufacturer of construction products and industrial components; sells goods rather than leasing buildings."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Building systems and facility services provider; earns service fees rather than rental income from property."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Leases senior housing and medical properties to healthcare operators, a different property type and tenant base than offices."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants under long-term leases, matching the target's business model and customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns hotels and resorts earning guest room and food revenue from travelers, not long-term office leases."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns suburban shopping centers leased to retailers; a different property type and tenant base from offices."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Self-storage facilities renting units to individuals and small businesses on short monthly terms, not office leases."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns hotels and sells overnight rooms to travelers; a hospitality business, not office property leasing."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Provides management and advisory services to REITs for fees; it does not own or lease office space."}]}
